definition: to take hold of something and move it
description: Outdoors on a sunny day, a big man in a bright floral shirt swings a heavy duffel bag onto his shoulder, then leans hard into a luggage trolley loaded with three suitcases and a cool box and shoves it along the road. At a silver van he heaves case after case into the boot until it is crammed full, shuts it, and turns to the camera grinning and out of breath.

taps.phrase: to load suitcases into a van
